title: Pareto-Informed Smart "Predict, then Optimize" for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Problems
abstract: arXiv:2611.23076v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many real-world planning applications, from logistics, routing to resource allocation, give rise to optimization problems that need to balance multiple, conflicting objectives. While machine learning is often used to predict the unknown parameters or costs of these problems, standard models trained on prediction accuracy can lead to suboptimal plans. Decision-Focused Learning (DFL) addresses this by integrating the downstream optimization task into the training objective. However, existing DFL methods for multi-objective problems rely on simple scalarization, which fails to capture the rich trade-offs of the Pareto Frontier. To address this gap, we propose a Pareto-aware extension to single-objective Smart "Predict, then Optimize" (SPO+) for multi-objective combinatorial optimization problems. Our loss function leverages the true Pareto Frontier, forming a target decision that aligns with a sampled preference vector, and minimizes regret

translated_title: 面向多目标组合问题的帕累托感知智能“预测后优化”方法
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的规划应用，从物流、路径规划到资源分配，都会产生需要平衡多个相互冲突目标的优化问题。虽然机器学习常被用于预测这些问题的未知参数或成本，但基于预测精度训练的标准模型可能导致次优的规划方案。决策聚焦学习通过将下游优化任务整合到训练目标中来解决这一问题。然而，现有的多目标问题DFL方法依赖于简单的标量化，无法捕捉帕累托前沿上丰富的权衡关系。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一种帕累托感知的扩展方法，将单目标智能“预测后优化”方法扩展到多目标组合优化问题。我们的损失函数利用真实的帕累托前沿，构建与采样偏好向量相一致的目标决策，并最小化遗憾。
tldr: 提出了一种帕累托感知的SPO+扩展方法，利用真实帕累托前沿构建与采样偏好向量对齐的目标决策并最小化遗憾，克服了现有决策聚焦学习方法在多目标组合优化中因简单标量化而无法捕捉丰富权衡关系的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Pareto-aware extension of SPO+ that leverages the true Pareto Frontier to form target decisions aligned with sampled preference vectors and minimize regret, overcoming the limitation of simple scalarization in existing decision-focused learning methods for multi-objective combinatorial optimization.
